title: univ3-pool-lens belongs on your radar
description:
This repo should be on your radar: moxailoo/univ3-pool-lens. A focused TypeScript toolkit for inspecting Uniswap V3 pools — liquidity distribution, fee yield, and impermanent-loss math from your terminal. It has about 607 GitHub stars, and it is active enough to deserve a closer look. Save this for your next build, and follow for more useful developer tools.

https://github.com/moxailoo/univ3-pool-lens

#GitHub #OpenSource #Developer #Programming #Shorts
